text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Ace-san. Won't you pick out an 
outfit for me~?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Man, you'd probably be better off asking 
someone else... Palmer, you know I'm 
totally clueless about that kind of stuff, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but Ace-san went out of her way to 
get me this eyeliner for my birthday. I 
wanna wear clothes that match it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And then, let's go out together! I wanna 
brag to everyone that Ace-san picked this 
out for me♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? No, wait wait wait!! That's way too 
huge of a responsibility!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even with the eyeliner, all I did was pick 
the color and just nod along to whatever 
the clerk said, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, you remembered my favorite color 
and went out of your way to buy it for me, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes me so happy! If 
anything, could you at least pick out the 
color for me? Please, <username>~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, if you put it that way... Ah, 
fine, your outfit, right? Let's see it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Yellow... No, maybe green is 
better? ...This feels a bit too flashy, 
though... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you didn't have to stress over it 
that much! I told you I'd be happy with 
anything you picked, Ace-san.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be able to sleep at night if we 
did that. Since you left it to me, I'm 
gonna pick out the best one!
